About Me

Hi there! My name is Ruilin Wu, and you can call me Ryan. I am currently a senior at Davidson College studying Biology and Computer Science.


I am fascinated by the beauty and complexity of biological systems, and I love using computational methods to unravel the mysteries of life. I aspire to be a scientist studying in the joint field of biology and computer science, such as systems biology, computational biology, and bioinformatics.


In my free time, I enjoy working out, watching movies, listening to good music,and exploring new restaurants.
Thank you for visiting my website!
